evidence_label_rule: every metric is HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator gems57-pooled-hide-v2) or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED; none is ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED in this run
fold_design: vendor/gems57/holdout.buffered_component_draw seeds 20,21 buffer 3 px boundary 12 px (same as the H88-ADHR run; n withheld positives must equal 22,893)
primary_endpoint: pooled far-subset HOLDOUT-DTI (withheld positives >10 px from every visible catalogue pixel); secondary: overall pooled HOLDOUT-DTI
why_far_subset: DrivenData staff (thread 11536): a new fault is any fault pixel not already captured by USGS/INGENIOUS; lineage arithmetic (evidence/h33_forensics_20261024.json) shows dots within 2 px of the catalogue only lowered public scores; D2 (evidence/proxy_calibration_20261024.json) shows no catalogue-based or SGMC-based proxy rank-orders the high public scores, so near-catalogue recovery is not trusted as evidence.

hypotheses.E1_FBMT: Training on the population the model will be tested on (isolated mapped faults vs far-basin background; neighbourhoods of dense networks unlabeled) transfers better to faults far from the catalogue than all-positive training (BASE-44).
hypotheses.E2_CCR: Where smoothed geophysical evidence exceeds what the smoothed visible-catalogue density usually accompanies, faults are more likely unmapped; boosting by exp(0.5*clip(z,+-2)) raises far-subset DTI.
hypotheses.E3_RCP: Real faults are laterally continuous; down-weighting short disconnected ridge candidates (bbox diagonal < 12 px) raises precision.

decision_rules.leakage: STOP if any single-feature symmetric AUC > 0.90
decision_rules.E1_keep: far-subset pooled DTI(fbmt) > far DTI(base) AND paired 95% CI of the difference excludes 0
decision_rules.E2_keep: far DTI(fbmt_ccr) > far DTI(fbmt) AND paired 95% CI excludes 0; otherwise report negative and drop CCR
decision_rules.E3_keep: far DTI(fbmt_ccr_rcp) > far DTI(kept predecessor) AND paired 95% CI excludes 0; otherwise drop RCP
decision_rules.promote_verdict: promote-to-selector-only requires (a) canary pass, (b) a kept arm whose far-subset DTI exceeds the stored H88-ADHR far-subset 0.11478 OR overall DTI exceeds 0.18789 (cross-run comparison on identical folds/evaluator), (c) uniqueness gate pass, (d) portal-format gate pass; otherwise verdict negative-or-hold
decision_rules.no_slot_policy: no DrivenData slot is spent by this run; promotion is a separate selector step

known_limits: hide-and-recover truth is catalogue faults, not the hidden new-fault labels
H33-class rasters are not scorable on this instrument (IR-88-20/35)
16/19 early proxies do not rank-order public scores (D2)
